parallel.requirements: Recognized the task as pure JavaScript AES-CBC with ESM imports/exports, .mjs files, manual argv parsing, local modules only, no external dependencies, no node:crypto cipher interface, UTF-8 encoding, CBC state across two encrypt calls, and Python bytes repr output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Entered swarm mode but stated the task was small and cohesive and that subagents would create interface conflicts and duplicate work; the main actor retained all implementation, integration, testing, and delivery ownership.
parallel.implementation: Wrote a direct AES block implementation plus CBC, Python bytes repr, argparse, and test7 entry modules under /output; the code was split across lib/aes.mjs, lib/cbc.mjs, lib/pyrepr.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and test7.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The main actor wrote all modules in one workspace and imported local .mjs helpers from the entrypoint; artifact validation later copied test7.mjs plus four lib files as the deliverable.
parallel.verification: Ran the executable on a sample, checked help and missing-argument behavior, ran all four samples through Node, ran 60 random comparisons against the executable, and checked missing, equals-form, and unknown-argument behavior.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite local checks, the official completed evaluator failed the solution at 5/28, so hidden cases or evaluator-aligned behavior remained incorrect; there was no child work, handoff, merge, or parallel completion gap.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same pure ESM Node.js migration requirements, including local module imports, manual process.argv parsing, no external dependencies, no node:crypto cipher interface, AES-CBC encryption, UTF-8 conversion, and Python bytes repr output.
serial.plan_and_ownership: As a serial control, the main actor owned all stages directly: environment check, AES core, CBC wrapper, repr helper, argparse helper, entrypoint, verification, one parser correction, and final delivery.
serial.implementation: Wrote lib/aes-core.mjs, lib/aes-cbc.mjs, lib/pybytes.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and test7.mjs; after fuzzing exposed an argparse mismatch for option-like values, edited argparse.mjs to reject such tokens as values.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The entrypoint imported the local helper modules with .mjs suffixes, artifact validation copied test7.mjs and the four serial lib modules, and there was no cross-agent integration boundary.
serial.verification: Checked environment, compared sample case 1 with the executable, diffed all four prompt samples, fuzzed 40 random cases, corrected parser behavior, reran the fuzz with stdout, stderr, and exit-code comparison, and reran sample plus missing-argument checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official completed evaluator also failed at 5/28, indicating remaining hidden-case incompatibility despite serial local verification; the defect is not attributable to delegation because no delegation occurred.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed records produce a both_fail relation: parallel and serial each passed 5 of 28 samples and each has solution_passed false. The trajectories differ in local verification path and module naming, and the serial run visibly fixed one argparse edge found by fuzzing, but there is no official outcome split to explain. The main parallel-specific fact is that swarm mode was entered but no child, AgentSwarm call, or delegation occurred, so the parallel run cannot support a concurrency-error label.
parallel_contributors: Parallel retained all work in the main actor despite swarm-mode context and produced a local AES-CBC implementation that passed its self-selected tests but failed hidden official coverage.
serial_contributors: Serial also produced a local AES-CBC implementation, corrected one parser edge during fuzzing, and still failed hidden official coverage at the same rate.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used files named aes.mjs, cbc.mjs, pyrepr.mjs, argparse.mjs, and test7.mjs; serial used aes-core.mjs, aes-cbc.mjs, pybytes.mjs, argparse.mjs, and test7.mjs.
Serial observed an option-like data value mismatch during fuzzing and patched argparse.mjs, while the parallel trajectory did not show that failed intermediate test.
